title: Ancestry Hint Triage Backlog
dataSources: Hints (`genealogy:hint`), cemetery visits (`genealogy:cemetery`), family-photo work (`genealogy:photo`), research ops (`genealogy:ops`).
app: Genealogy and family-history telemetry — Ancestry hints, cemetery visit logs, and photo-restoration queues — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:hint hint_type=* triage_state=*
| stats sum(eval(if(triage_state!="done",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by hint_type
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending untriaged hints backlog by hint type for Ancestry hint review.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside Ancestry hint review.
implementation: Mark each `genealogy:hint` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `hint_type`.
visualization: Table of hint type with pending untriaged hints counts.
grandmaExplanation: It measures where unfinished untriaged hints are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in Ancestry hint review.
